purpose: Large civil structures through public purpose, design basis, construction, capacity, inspection, maintenance, safety, and local effects.

Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.

Name structure, jurisdiction, date, and design basis. Distinguish modeled from observed performance; avoid unsafe operational details or declaring a facility safe from a single metric.
